# Milestone 6 (part): Sections 6 to 8 under the GSS design, against the population share (generated by run.py)

228 cells (pair x item); 227 groups in families, 835 group x budget rows. Ultimate-cluster (with-replacement PSU) variances with GSS strata and PSUs; 1972-74 rows are their own PSUs. Phase 2 simple random within the target.

## Checks

- refit against m6_allocation: 228 of 228 cells matched; largest |bias| difference 0.0000 points
- sample-share MSE of P0 recomputed here against m6_prior's: largest relative difference 3.16e-13

## Phase-1 errors of the full target sample

- median V_y: 8.42e-05 (sd 0.92 points); median deff of y 1.058
- median V_f / V_y: 0.209 (quartiles 0.123, 0.311)
- median correlation of eps_f and eps_y: 0.453 (quartiles 0.353, 0.554)
